patch_description: Keeps the triangular-lattice seeding and the exact LP radius solve from the context programs, but replaces the plateau-prone greedy hill-climb with simulated annealing: temperature-based acceptance of slightly worse moves, geometric cooling, adaptive step size, and reheating (temperature resets) after 50 rejected steps without improvement. This lets the search escape local optima that capped the previous version at ~2.40, moving toward the 2.635 target.
